criteria_evaluated: iOS Dynamic Type (Default up to AX5 Accessibility)

ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.font_scale_resilience: PASS. Compose Auto-Wrap in cards prevents truncation at 2.0x scale; labels expand vertically without clipping.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.screen_reader_semantics: PASS. Clear accessibilityElements with semantics(mergeDescendants = true) on cards.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.color_independence: PASS. Badges pair distinct glyphs ([●], [◷], [☁], [◌]) with explicit English/Odia text.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.reduce_motion: PASS. Transitions cleanly swap to instantaneous alpha crossfades when animation scale = 0.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.touch_targets: PASS. All chips and icons maintain >= 48dp bounding boxes.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.map_alternative: PASS. Dedicated 'View List of Places' button in top toolbar.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.contrast_ratio: PASS. 4.8:1 minimum text contrast; 7:1 for headline titles.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.odia_legibility: PASS. System font cascade handles Odia conjuncts with sufficient line-height (1.4x).

ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.font_scale_resilience: PASS. Compact tables reflow cleanly into single-column layout at 2.0x scale.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.screen_reader_semantics: PASS. Very concise, easy to traverse with TalkBack.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.color_independence: PASS. Uses high-contrast letter codes ([V], [S], [E]) alongside icons.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.touch_targets: PASS. Exceeds 48dp on all primary field actions.

ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.font_scale_resilience: FAIL. 24dp card padding and fixed aspect ratio image slots caused text overlap and clipping at 2.0x scale.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.screen_reader_semantics: MARGINAL. Decorative flourishes and pull quotes cluttered TalkBack traversal.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.color_independence: MARGINAL. Relied on subtle terracotta tones that color-blind travelers found difficult to distinguish from muted slate.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.map_alternative: MARGINAL. Hidden inside a secondary menu.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.contrast_ratio: MARGINAL. Terracotta text on dark background failed 4.5:1 ratio (measured 3.8:1).
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.odia_legibility: FAIL. Stylized decorative serif font caused clipping of Odia dependent vowel signs (matras).

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.font_scale_resilience: PASS. Full SwiftUI Dynamic Type reflow. Cards switch from HStack to VStack automatically at AX3–AX5 sizes.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.screen_reader_semantics: PASS. Unified VoiceOver cards with accessibilityLabel, accessibilityHint, and accessibilityValue.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.color_independence: PASS. Capsule badges combine SF Symbols with textual descriptions.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.reduce_motion: PASS. Fully respects UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled; springs swap to fades.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.touch_targets: PASS. All interactive buttons maintain >= 44pt touch area.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.map_alternative: PASS. Direct navigation toolbar button exposes accessible SwiftUI List of all annotations.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.contrast_ratio: PASS. Meets WCAG 2.2 AA in both Light and Dark system appearances.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.odia_legibility: PASS. System Kohinoor Odia renders all juktakkhara ligatures without truncation.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.font_scale_resilience: MARGINAL. Floating map cards crowded the screen and overlapped pins at AX2+ sizes.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.screen_reader_semantics: FAIL. Spatial map annotations without an automatic list fallback made screen reader navigation painful.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.map_alternative: FAIL. Required opening a secondary drawer.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.contrast_ratio: FAIL. Translucent frosted glass over bright photo backgrounds caused text contrast to dip below 3.5:1 without 'Reduce Transparency' active.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.odia_legibility: MARGINAL. Complex Odia ligatures blurred against frosted backgrounds in outdoor bright mode.

summary: Android A (Atlas Material), Android B (Field Guide), and iOS A (Editorial Atlas) cleanly passed all accessibility and resilience gates. Android C, iOS B, and iOS C failed on contrast, text clipping, or screen reader ergonomics.
